---
title: "Wildfires"
author: "Eliza"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)

raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson")
nrow(raw$features)

fire <- raw$features[1, ]
names(fire)
fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][1, 1, ]

fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lon = purrr::map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) mean(coordinates[[1]][, , 1])),
    lat = purrr::map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) mean(coordinates[[1]][, , 2]))
  )
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(gis_acres)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    boundary = purrr::map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(coordinates) coordinates[[1]][1, , ]
    )
  )

all_lons <- unlist(purrr::map(largest_fires$boundary, \(coordinates) coordinates[, 1]))
all_lats <- unlist(purrr::map(largest_fires$boundary, \(coordinates) coordinates[, 2]))

fire_map <- leaflet::leaflet() |>
  leaflet::addTiles() |>
  leaflet::fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(all_lons),
    lat1 = min(all_lats),
    lng2 = max(all_lons),
    lat2 = max(all_lats)
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(largest_fires))) {
  coordinates <- largest_fires$boundary[[i]]
  fire_map <- leaflet::addPolygons(
    fire_map,
    lng = coordinates[, 1],
    lat = coordinates[, 2],
    popup = paste0(
      "Fire: ", largest_fires$incident[i],
      "<br>Year: ", largest_fires$fire_year[i],
      "<br>Acres: ", format(round(largest_fires$gis_acres[i]), big.mark = ",")
    )
  )
}

fire_map
```

```{r}
fires |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(state)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(state) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = total_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = forcats::fct_reorder(state, total_acres), y = total_acres)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Top 10 States by Acres Burned",
    x = "State",
    y = "Total acres burned",
    caption = "Source: wildfire records in data/wildfires.geojson"
  )
```
